page_title: WOL 2-6 CHE | Wolves v Chelsea 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' A clumsy foul by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) and Darren England blows his whistle.
90+5' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
90+4' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mario Lemina as he is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
90' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
90' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
89' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

89' Joao Felix (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
87' Joao Gomes (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
86' Robert Sanchez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
86' Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick. An attempted cross from Daniel Podence (Wolves) is cleared.
85' Joao Gomes (Wolves) tries to find Pablo Sarabia with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
83' Enzo Maresca decides to make a substitution. Marc Cucurella will be replaced by Renato Veiga (Chelsea).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is coming onto the pitch as Cole Palmer cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' 2 - 6 Joao Felix (Chelsea) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top left corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
80' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Wolves due to an offside in the build-up play.
79' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolves players aren’t happy.
79' Goal! Mario Lemina (Wolves) beats the goalkeeper with his effort.
76' Enzo Maresca is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Moises Caicedo suffers an injury and Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) comes on.
71' A yellow card for bad language! Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
71' Darren England shows a yellow card to Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
71' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
70' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
70' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
68' It is time for a substitution. Joao Felix (Chelsea) is on for Nicolas Jackson.
68' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde did his best and is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
68' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Matheus Cunha is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
68' It's time for a substitution. Craig Dawson (Wolves) comes on in place of Rayan Ait-Nouri.
66' Chelsea continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
66' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Chelsea get a free kick.
63' 2 - 5 Cole Palmer provides Noni Madueke (Chelsea) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
59' Substitution. Daniel Podence (Wolves) on for Hee-Chan Hwang.
58' 2 - 4 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Cole Palmer finds Noni Madueke (Chelsea) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:4.
58' A rebound falls kindly for Mario Lemina (Wolves), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
58' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
55' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) makes a strong challenge and Darren England blows for a foul.
51' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
49' 2 - 3 Goal! Cole Palmer plays it to Noni Madueke (Chelsea), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Jose Sa. 2:3.
46' Substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk leaves the pitch and is replaced by Pedro Neto (Chelsea).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+8' The game is interrupted now, Joao Gomes (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Toti displays great vision and sends a pass to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 2:2.
45+5' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) and blew his whistle. Wolves have a free kick.
45+4' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+3' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 2 What a finish that is! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sees that Jose Sa is off his line and scores with a brilliant lob from the edge of the box. He makes it 1:2.
44' The referee shows a yellow card to Cole Palmer (Chelsea). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
43' The resulting corner from Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
42' OFF THE BAR! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
41' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Robert Sanchez to dive and make a save.
40' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
39' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
38' Darren England blows his whistle after Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
36' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
35' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
32' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
31' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) threads a pass through to Nicolas Jackson, but Jose Sa breaks up the move.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Rayan Ait-Nouri, then sends the ball inside the right post. 1:1.
25' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Darren England blows his whistle as Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
21' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' Jose Sa (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
19' Jose Sa (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
19' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
18' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jose Sa with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
17' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Matheus Cunha (Wolves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
15' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
13' Mario Lemina (Wolves) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Matheus Cunha, but Robert Sanchez displays great awareness to stop him.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' What a chance! Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) rises high to connect with the resulting corner inside the box, but his bullet header rattles the right post.
9' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
7' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
2' 0 - 1 Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.
2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.

2' What a wasted opportunity by Noni Madueke (Chelsea)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Chelsea will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Darren England.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
